pages.title: AMReye.AI Product Technology and Research Compendium
text: An integrated view of the proposed hardware, software and services for plate observation, traceable measurement and antimicrobial susceptibility research.
**Prepared for technical partners, laboratories and controlled investor review.**

AMReye.AI develops from a practical measurement priority: an endpoint disk diffusion reader with controlled imaging, spatial calibration, quality assessment, versioned interpretation and mandatory human review. The broader programme investigates multimodal observation, laboratory automation and predictive models.

This compendium describes product intent, engineering choices and the evidence required to advance them. It does not represent a clinically validated or cleared diagnostic device. Literature findings belong to their original studies; proposed capabilities require their own evaluation.
14 September 2026
**Controlled external review edition**

pages.title: Purpose and scope of controlled review
text: This compendium presents a proposed product platform for laboratory observation, measurement and research. Its readers should be able to determine what a module is intended to do, what physical or computational principle supports it, what evidence is missing and what would have to be demonstrated before deployment.
## Scope of the review

The central development priority is Reader V1, an endpoint disk diffusion imaging and measurement system. The wider portfolio includes integrated instruments, research imaging, automation, software and services. These share recordkeeping and engineering principles, but their intended uses and evidence requirements differ. A research imaging result should not acquire a clinical meaning simply because it appears in the same interface as a laboratory record.
## Distribution and interpretation

This edition is intended for controlled external review. The product concepts, diagrams and interfaces describe engineering intent. They are not instructions for patient treatment, evidence of regulatory clearance or confirmation that every proposed module has been built. Clinical use would require an appropriate intended use, completed validation and applicable authorization.

Financial projections, fundraising scenarios and proposed selling prices are outside the book. A dated Reader V1 candidate bill of materials appears at the end to make one engineering configuration inspectable. Component prices are purchasing observations or explicitly identified estimates, not a validated cost of a finished medical device.

pages.title: The product proposition
text: AMReye.AI aims to make laboratory observations easier to acquire consistently, inspect critically and preserve with their context. The first useful unit of value is a trustworthy measurement record: an image associated with the correct plate, a valid calibration, a reproducible measurement and a review decision that can be reconstructed.
## A platform built around observation

A plate contains more information than a final diameter alone. Its appearance, temporal development and measurement conditions can support quality assessment and research. Multiple sensing methods may add complementary information, but each added channel also introduces calibration, maintenance and interpretation work. The platform therefore treats integration as a question of demonstrated information value.
## What success would look like

A successful endpoint reader would reduce avoidable measurement and transcription variability while preserving laboratory oversight. A successful research platform would produce observations that other investigators can interpret, compare and challenge. A successful deployment would remain usable when connectivity is interrupted and would make failed or uncertain results visible.

The common aim is better evidence at the point where a laboratory makes a decision. Speed, automation and AI are valuable when they improve that evidence or reduce a verified operational burden. They are not substitutes for method suitability, traceability or biological validation.

pages.title: Reading the maturity of a capability
text: Capability maturity is expressed by what has been demonstrated, not by the sophistication of its name. The same module can have a working software demonstration, an unqualified measurement chain and no clinical validation. Those are different states and should remain distinguishable.
## Read the scope with the result

A reported agreement percentage is incomplete without the tested population, comparator, denominator, excluded cases and uncertainty. A short assay time is incomplete without its clock origin. A simulation is incomplete without the last real observation and the horizon over which it predicts.

No clinical accuracy, sub-two-hour performance, resistance-gene identification from plate images or zero-error operation is established for AMReye.AI by this compendium. Those ambitions are translated into testable research and engineering requirements. The near-term product path prioritizes controlled endpoint measurement and human review; broader capabilities advance through separate evidence gates.

This vocabulary should help technical partners compare proposals fairly. It also protects useful exploratory ideas from being discarded merely because they are not ready for clinical use. Research potential and readiness for deployment are separate assessments.

pages.title: How the platform fits laboratory work
text: A laboratory result emerges from a chain of activities. Specimen collection, transport, processing, organism identification, susceptibility testing, review and communication can each contribute delay or uncertainty. An instrument can improve a particular step without controlling the whole chain.
## Measure the contribution at the right boundary

Reader acquisition time, analysis latency and total laboratory turnaround should be reported separately. A fast image measurement cannot recover time already spent in specimen transport or biological growth. Similarly, an early research signal may not yet be a reportable susceptibility result.

The proposed software should make these boundaries visible through distinct timestamps. Where a timestamp is missing, elapsed time should be unavailable rather than inferred silently. Partners can then identify the stage that actually limits their service and assess whether a reader, workflow integration or a different assay would address it.

Acquire a controlled image and verify identity, calibration and readability.
Preserve measured values; apply a separately versioned eligible ruleset.

Export the reviewed state, retain acknowledgements and preserve corrections.

## Suggested reading paths

Laboratory reviewers can begin with Reader V1, routine disk diffusion, human review and measurement validation. Engineering partners can move directly to sensing, interfaces and the development sequence. Research collaborators should connect a candidate modality to its evidence synthesis, application boundary and validation plan.

Investors should read the product portfolio together with development gates and service requirements. The breadth of the platform is an opportunity map; it is not a promise that every proposed family will be delivered in one instrument or one development cycle.

pages.title: Abbreviations for microbiology and measurement
text: Abbreviations are expanded at first use where practical. The definitions below keep similar-looking biological and measurement terms distinct.

The presence of an abbreviation in this glossary does not establish product capability. For example, MIC prediction is a research track; a reviewed disk-zone diameter should not be presented as a measured MIC. Standards terminology must be interpreted within the selected method and document version. [R01] [R02]
tables: Minimum inhibitory concentration, defined by the applicable testing method.
Broth microdilution, a method family used for quantitative susceptibility testing.
Quality control of a method, instrument or process, with the object identified.
Rapid AST within a specified method and eligible conditions; EUCAST uses this term for its defined pathway.
Area of technical uncertainty in applicable EUCAST interpretation contexts.
Colony-forming unit, an operational estimate dependent on the counting method.
Polymerase chain reaction; distinguish real-time PCR from reverse-transcription PCR when discussing a molecular result.
Optical density or absorbance-related measurement, with wavelength and optical geometry stated.
Relative humidity, normally expressed as a percentage.
Field of view at a specified object plane.
Signal-to-noise ratio with its calculation and units or logarithmic convention stated.
Modulation transfer function, describing contrast transfer across spatial frequencies.

pages.title: Abbreviations for software and engineering
text: Software and engineering terms can obscure responsibility when used loosely. Here, each term refers to a defined function or record, rather than a claim that a particular architecture has been implemented.

“Edge” means computation close to the instrument; “cloud” means managed remote computing services. Neither word alone specifies security, reliability or performance. “Digital twin” is reserved for a model-linked representation whose relationship to observations and uncertainty is explicit.
tables: Artificial intelligence, including task-specific learned models.

Coordinated Universal Time, suitable for unambiguous stored event times.
Indian Standard Time, UTC plus five hours and thirty minutes.

pages.title: Questions this compendium answers
text: The book is organized around decisions that a serious reviewer should be able to examine. Each answer connects the proposed benefit to a mechanism and an evidence requirement.

An unanswered question should lead to a defined research or engineering task. It should not be concealed by a broad capability label. The strongest product proposition is one whose limitations are specific enough to be tested and whose useful functions remain clear within those limits.
